caption: The drawing depicts a single object: a brown, fur-textured cap with a bill, resembling an aviator or hunting cap. The cap is shown in profile, facing left, and occupies the central portion of an otherwise blank, light beige or off-white background. The texture of the cap is illustrated with short, uneven strokes to suggest the appearance of fur or rough fabric. The bill protrudes outward and downward, and is outlined with a darker shade along its edge. There is a faint seam visible where the brim joins the crown of the cap. The overall color is a mixture of lighter and darker browns, and the image contains no additional objects or decorative elements. There are some small, handwritten notations in the lower right corner of the drawing, including numbers and a name.
title: Sealskin Cap
